summary: Iteration 8 testing: i18n (EN/ES), Admin Reply, Admin User Management, Logout redirect fix. Backend: 22/22 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All critical flows tested and working. One i18n issue found: Homepage hero section (CTA buttons, subtitle paragraph, features/stats arrays) uses hardcoded English strings instead of i18n keys.

issues: Hero CTA buttons 'Become a Partner' (line 151) and 'Partner Login' (line 159) are hardcoded in English - don't translate to Spanish when language is switched
Hero subtitle paragraph (lines 135-138) is hardcoded in English - should use t('home.heroSubtitle')
features array (lines 9-25), stats array (lines 27-32), and benefits array (lines 34-40) are static English arrays - not using i18n keys
Login page left panel 'Welcome back' text (line 72 LoginPage.js) is hardcoded - minor decorative element
Register page left panel 'Join our partner network' heading is hardcoded - minor decorative element

action_items: Fix HomePage.js hero CTA buttons to use {t('home.becomePartner')} and {t('home.partnerLogin')} (lines 151, 159)
Fix HomePage.js hero subtitle paragraph to use {t('home.heroSubtitle')} (lines 135-138)
Fix HomePage.js static arrays (features, stats, benefits) to use i18n keys or move to translation files
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.js: Hero section has partial i18n - badge and title use t() correctly, but CTA buttons, subtitle, features array, stats array, and benefits array use hardcoded English strings. The nav buttons DO use t('nav.login') and t('nav.getStarted') correctly.
HomePage.js lines 9-25: features array is a module-level constant with hardcoded English text. These should either be inside the component using t() or defined in the translation files.

All new features are well-implemented: Admin reply (POST /api/admin/contact/{id}/reply), Admin users (GET /api/admin/users), LanguageSwitcher component (works in all pages), Contact Us tab in partner dashboard, logout redirect.
AuthContext.js logout() correctly uses window.location.replace('/') - partner and admin logout both redirect to homepage as verified.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all flows functional, partial i18n coverage issue on homepage (static text sections)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Inquiry_Iteration8 contact inquiry via backend tests. Created 'UI Test Inquiry - Iteration 8 Contact Tab' via frontend UI testing. Backend test also replied to an inquiry via POST /api/admin/contact/{id}/reply.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 complete. All new features working: 1) i18n EN/ES - LanguageSwitcher works on all pages (homepage, login, register, admin dashboard, partner dashboard). Homepage nav buttons, badge, hero title DO translate. But hero CTA buttons and static arrays are hardcoded. 2) Admin Reply flow - POST /api/admin/contact/{id}/reply works, reply shown in UI with 'Your reply' section, partner sees reply via GET /api/contact. 3) Admin User Management - GET /api/admin/users returns partner users, toggle button works, table shows 15+ users. 4) Logout redirect - both admin and partner logout redirect to '/' (homepage). KEY ISSUE: HomePage.js has partial i18n - CTA buttons (Become a Partner, Partner Login) and hero subtitle and feature/stats arrays are hardcoded in English.
rca_of_issue: Partial i18n in HomePage.js: The component was partially updated to use react-i18next for nav buttons, badge, and hero title, but the hero section CTA buttons (lines 151, 159) and the hero subtitle paragraph (lines 135-138) were NOT updated to use t() calls. Additionally, the module-level constant arrays (features, stats, benefits on lines 9-40) were not moved into the component or converted to i18n keys. Fix: Replace hardcoded strings in hero section and feature arrays with t() calls using the already-defined translation keys in en.json (home.becomePartner, home.partnerLogin, home.heroSubtitle, home.features.*, home.stats.*, home.why.b1-b5).
